youtube.title: Big, Bigger, Biggest! 🎈 Size Words for Kids | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Welcome to the Big Balloon Contest! Robo, Duck and Chick learn to compare by eye: big, bigger, biggest; small, smaller, smallest; and tall, taller, tallest. Line things up at the bottom to compare fairly. Then a twist: Duck is big next to Chick, and small next to Cow. Big is a comparing word!

Try it at home with a grown-up: put 3 plastic cups in order from smallest to biggest, line up 3 shoes, and build two towers side by side. Please don't use real balloons with little ones: they are a choking risk.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for preschool.

do.text: Three balloons. Let's pump them up!
Pump, pump! Duck's balloon grows more.
Pump, pump, pump! Robo's balloon grows and grows!
Whoa! Robo is on his tiptoes!
Who wins? Let's find out what big means!
Say it with me. Arms out a little. Big!
As wide as you can. Biggest!
Now let's go the other way!
And this tiny ball is the smallest!
Biggest is wide. Smallest is tiny!
An ostrich lays the biggest bird egg.
A hummingbird egg is tiny, like a jelly bean!
Wait! I can make this one the tallest.
Look! The yellow tower is the tallest!
Oops! It is standing on a box.
We line them up at the bottom.
Now which tower is the tallest?
The blue one! Four blocks. Tallest!
Giraffes are the tallest animals in the world!
Stand on tiptoe. Tall, taller, tallest!
Let's line them up. Smallest first.
Which gift comes next? Smaller or bigger?
Next to Chick, Duck is big!
Next to Cow, Duck is small!
Duck is the same. Her friend changed.
Duck is big next to Chick. Duck is small next to Cow.
Big is a comparing word. We compare!
And even I am small next to a blue whale!
The blue whale is the biggest animal ever!
Size quiz! One. Which balloon is the biggest?
Two. Which ball is the smallest?
Three. All on the line. Which tower is the tallest?
The blue one, with four blocks!
Four. Next to Cow, is Duck big or small?
The biggest balloon. The best colour. The bounciest!
Big, bigger, biggest! Small, smaller, smallest!
Line them up and look! Bye-bye!
